improve.title: Defensive work rate
tips: As a CDM/CM, screen the back line: stay between the ball and our goal and pick off passes.
When the ball is lost, the nearest player presses and everyone else closes the passing lanes.
Make yourself big in the box when they shoot. Blocks count, even if the stats don't.
improve.coach: 50% of matches overall, down to 20% recently. Keep chipping away.

improve.title: Forcing passes
tips: Below about 72% the extra passes start costing us. Pick the simple option until the touch comes back.
If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.
A sideways pass that keeps the ball is worth more than a forward one that loses it.
improve.coach: Steady at about 50% of matches. Steady means fixable; it's a habit, not a fluke.

improve.title: On-ball involvement
tips: Move after you pass. A pass-and-move player is always an option.
Check away, then check back. A two-yard feint buys you the space to receive.
Give the passer an angle - diagonal to the ball, not flat in a line where it can't reach you.
improve.coach: 38% of matches, right in line with your recent form. A good one to drill.

strengths.title: Chance creation
strengths.coach: Selfless as a church potluck, and twice as filling. 50% of matches. That's not luck; that's who you are.

strengths.title: Goal threat
strengths.coach: You put it where the keeper ain't. That's the whole trick. There in 50% of your matches. Build your game around it.

coach.intro: Alright tuxedo_slide, 8 matches in. Let's talk patterns, the good and the growing.
coach.name: Coach Lasso
